area_center_gray — MV gray op

• Data kinds: image2d → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.area_center_gray(image, region=None) (to call the implementation directly, import image_gray; image_gray.area_center_gray(image, region=None); from the registry, opsmv.get("area_center_gray"))

• HALCON equivalent: area_center_gray (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Return the gray-weighted mass and centroid (row, col).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

region を渡すとその画素だけを数える。質量が 0 なら area が 0.0 で重心は原点を返す(理由: 重みが無いと重心が定義できない)。空の入力(image が 0 要素)は ValueError。
